rows.transcript_gb_en_m:
Managing anger can be really difficult. Take a break when you feel you are getting angry at your children or someone else.

Go somewhere else for 5 minutes to regain control of your emotions. If you have a safe outdoor space, go outside. You can get through this!
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Menguruskan rasa marah memang tidak mudah. Bila anda mula rasa marah kepada anak‑anak atau sesiapa sahaja, cuba berhenti seketika.

Pergilah ke tempat lain selama 5 minit untuk menenangkan diri dan mengawal emosi anda. Jika ada ruang luar yang selamat, keluar sebentar.

Anda pasti mampu melalui saat ini!

text_1_facilitator.eng: 4️⃣ Here are four things you can do to support your child when they share something difficult with you:

section_1_text.eng:
🌱 Take a deep breath so you can respond calmly.
💛 Ask yourself, “What does my child need right now?”

section_2_title.eng: LISTEN: Ask your child what is going on

section_2_text.eng:
👂 Let your child share with you what they need.
👀 Notice what they are feeling and tell them what you notice so they feel heard. 
💙 Tell your child that you are there for them and love them.
😣 Both girls AND boys could face hard times and crisis situations. Remember to check-in with both.

section_3_title.eng: RESPOND: What might help what is going on?

section_3_text.eng:
🔶 You might need to help your child talk about their feelings or redirect their focus.
➡️ You might need to talk about the actions that you or your child could take to help with what has happened.
⏸ You can teach your child consequences later if needed. In the moment, your child needs you to be there for them with love.
✅ Remember, you can refer to the My Resources for a list of community resources where you can receive help.

section_4_title.eng: COMFORT: Be there for your child

section_4_text.eng:
🌷 It can be hard to see your child feeling upset or confused, but there is a lot you can do to support them.
💚 They need you to accept them and comfort them when difficult things are going on.
🎈 Remind your child again that you love them, and thank them for sharing with you.
